text: Joomi maa yamirii ma an oo jeyaaɗo, O toŋi rewugol ko wonaa Kanko, O yamiri moƴƴagol e jibimɓe ɓen ɗiɗo ; tentinii non tuma ɓe yottii nayeegu : si goɗɗo e mawɓe ɓen yottike nayeegu, maa ɓe ɗi ɗoo non ɓe nawyidii fewndo maa, wata a haaɓu haa haala hollirta a seytani, wata a gufu ɓe kadi wata a saɗtinamɓe konngol, wowlan ɓe konngol teddungol newiingol.
